mapper.sql: id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, name, description, cover_image_url, owner_id, status, source_language, narration_language, metadata_language, image_aspect_ratio, image_quality_tier, archived_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO projects ( row_version, created_at, updated_at, name, description, cover_image_url, owner_id, status, source_language, narration_language, metadata_language, image_aspect_ratio, image_quality_tier, archived_at ) VALUES ( #{rowVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{sourceLanguage}, #{narrationLanguage}, #{metadataLanguage}, #{imageAspectRatio}, #{imageQualityTier}, #{archivedAt} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, status = #{status}, source_language = #{sourceLanguage}, narration_language = #{narrationLanguage}, metadata_language = #{metadataLanguage}, image_aspect_ratio = #{imageAspectRatio}, image_quality_tier = #{imageQualityTier}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
